visibilityPredicate.description: An entity is visible when its axis-aligned screen-space bounding box intersects the viewport and sampled alpha is above the configured threshold.

browserStateContract.normalizeRule: If window.__gameState is a function, call it once per observation tick; otherwise read it as an object.

perceptualHash.note: String hash preferred. Numeric fallback is accepted by legacy evaluator paths.
